prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection won, whereas moving sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, path duration hints, and photo processing hints won, while account recovery hints hurt and many other hints showed no clear effect.
Personality-driven headline refreshes and live wait countdown timers won, whereas general story copy, time headlines, and photo quality guidance hurt or showed no clear effect.
Select layout redesigns (photo split layout, wait screen split layout) and specific control guide screens won, while sub-flows, trait selectors, and several major redesigns hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, adoption badges, and incentive callouts consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted hints, headline refreshes, live timers, and specific guide screens.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Screen Redesign: Redesign the home introduction screen to a split layout that clearly separates the welcome message from taskbar controls guidance. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding, and completion step conversion drops to 76.3%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Guide Screen Addition: Add a new dedicated guidance screen after home welcome that visually demonstrates taskbar tray interaction. (why: Three support emails noted confusion on controlling, hiding, or waking up the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Spotlight Layout Redesign: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight view to focus clearly on starter versus custom options. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s, indicating decision friction when comparing path options.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Companion Pick Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the companion pick screen into a two-column layout showing pet visual previews alongside key attributes. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the middle funnel (80.0%) and a high median time of 89s.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Companion Save Reassurance Hint: Add a targeted hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves their chosen pet across sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making persistence reassurance crucial.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Desktop Rendering Progress Hint: Display an explicit waiting hint that explains desktop companion asset rendering is underway. (why: Home waiting screen has a high median time of 201s (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop.)
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Quality Guidance Headline Refresh: Update headline and body copy on the photo upload screen to emphasize lighting and single-subject clarity. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or yielding unexpected visual results.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Desktop Pet Intro Copy Refresh: Refresh the story intro screen copy to succinctly explain what a desktop pet is and how it integrates into the system tray. (why: Setting clear expectations right at start reduces long deliberation times (choose_path mean is 514s).)
8: [adoption, hint] Certificate Persistence Backup Safety Hint: Add a certificate backup reassurance hint to the adoption certificate stage. (why: Reassuring users that adoption certificates and pet profiles are saved prevents drop-off before reaching the waiting screen.)
9: [finish, hint] System Tray Pet Quick Recovery Hint: Add a hint on the finish home intro screen explaining how to bring the pet back if hidden. (why: Multiple users reported post-onboarding confusion regarding hidden pets or missing desktop windows.)
